why: The route page puts this steep snow couloir on a 7,200 ft peak in the Susanville area of northeast California, where no glacier exists; the climb is a snow gully by a rock feature.
The word glacier only describes polished rock on a small Eastern Sierra craglet; no page I read says anything about snow there.
